001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
008import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
009import static org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.DecimalBounds.max;
010import static org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.DecimalBounds.min;
011import static org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator.DecimalBounds.mul;
012import org.clafer.common.Util;
013
014/**
015 * Division of decimals scaled by {@code one}:
016 * {@code quotient = divRound(dividend * one, divisor)}, rounded half away from
017 * zero, and {@code divisor != 0}. Bound consistent on the quotient; the
018 * dividend is narrowed by the bounds of the quotient.
019 *
020 * @author Michał Antkiewicz
021 */
022public class PropDecimalDiv extends Propagator<IntVar> {
023
024    private final IntVar dividend, divisor, quotient;
025    private final long one;
026
027    public PropDecimalDiv(IntVar dividend, IntVar divisor, IntVar quotient, int one) {
028        super(new IntVar[]{dividend, divisor, quotient}, PropagatorPriority.TERNARY, false);
029        if (one <= 0) {
030            throw new IllegalArgumentException("one must be positive");
031        }
032        this.dividend = dividend;
033        this.divisor = divisor;
034        this.quotient = quotient;
035        this.one = one;
036    }
037
038    @Override
039    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
040        return IntEventType.boundAndInst();
041    }
042
043    /**
044     * @return the bounds of the rounded quotient over the part of the divisor
045     * in {@code [low, high]}, a range without zero
046     */
047    private long[] quotientBounds(long low, long high) {
048        long dividendLow = mul(dividend.getLB(), one);
049        long dividendHigh = mul(dividend.getUB(), one);
050        long ll = Util.divRound(dividendLow, low);
051        long lh = Util.divRound(dividendLow, high);
052        long hl = Util.divRound(dividendHigh, low);
053        long hh = Util.divRound(dividendHigh, high);
054        return new long[]{min(ll, lh, hl, hh), max(ll, lh, hl, hh)};
055    }
056
057    /**
058     * @return the bounds of the rounded quotient
059     */
060    private long[] quotientBounds() {
061        long low = Long.MAX_VALUE;
062        long high = Long.MIN_VALUE;
063        if (divisor.getLB() < 0) {
064            long[] bounds = quotientBounds(divisor.getLB(), Math.min(divisor.getUB(), -1));
065            low = Math.min(low, bounds[0]);
066            high = Math.max(high, bounds[1]);
067        }
068        if (divisor.getUB() > 0) {
069            long[] bounds = quotientBounds(Math.max(divisor.getLB(), 1), divisor.getUB());
070            low = Math.min(low, bounds[0]);
071            high = Math.max(high, bounds[1]);
072        }
073        return new long[]{low, high};
074    }
075
076    /**
077     * {@code divRound(dividend * one, divisor)} is in {@code [zl, zh]} only if
078     * {@code dividend * one / divisor} is in {@code [zl - 1/2, zh + 1/2]}, ie.
079     * {@code 2 * dividend * one} is between {@code divisor * (2 * zl - 1)} and
080     * {@code divisor * (2 * zh + 1)}.
081     *
082     * @return the bounds of the dividend over the part of the divisor in
083     * {@code [low, high]}, a range without zero
084     */
085    private long[] dividendBounds(long low, long high) {
086        long zl = 2L * quotient.getLB() - 1;
087        long zh = 2L * quotient.getUB() + 1;
088        long ll = mul(low, zl);
089        long lh = mul(low, zh);
090        long hl = mul(high, zl);
091        long hh = mul(high, zh);
092        long twoOne = 2 * one;
093        return new long[]{
094            Util.divCeil(min(ll, lh, hl, hh), twoOne),
095            Util.divFloor(max(ll, lh, hl, hh), twoOne)};
096    }
097
098    @Override
099    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
100        boolean changed;
101        do {
102            changed = false;
103            if (divisor.getLB() == 0) {
104                changed |= divisor.updateLowerBound(1, this);
105            }
106            if (divisor.getUB() == 0) {
107                changed |= divisor.updateUpperBound(-1, this);
108            }
109            long[] bounds = quotientBounds();
110            changed |= DecimalBounds.updateBounds(quotient, bounds[0], bounds[1], this);
111            long low = Long.MAX_VALUE;
112            long high = Long.MIN_VALUE;
113            if (divisor.getLB() < 0) {
114                long[] part = dividendBounds(divisor.getLB(), Math.min(divisor.getUB(), -1));
115                low = Math.min(low, part[0]);
116                high = Math.max(high, part[1]);
117            }
118            if (divisor.getUB() > 0) {
119                long[] part = dividendBounds(Math.max(divisor.getLB(), 1), divisor.getUB());
120                low = Math.min(low, part[0]);
121                high = Math.max(high, part[1]);
122            }
123            changed |= DecimalBounds.updateBounds(dividend, low, high, this);
124        } while (changed);
125    }
126
127    @Override
128    public ESat isEntailed() {
129        if (divisor.isInstantiatedTo(0)) {
130            return ESat.FALSE;
131        }
132        if (isCompletelyInstantiated()) {
133            return ESat.eval(quotient.getValue()
134                    == Util.divRound((long) dividend.getValue() * one, divisor.getValue()));
135        }
136        long[] bounds = quotientBounds();
137        if (bounds[1] < quotient.getLB() || bounds[0] > quotient.getUB()) {
138            return ESat.FALSE;
139        }
140        return ESat.UNDEFINED;
141    }
142
143    @Override
144    public String toString() {
145        return quotient + " = round(" + dividend + " * " + one + " / " + divisor + ")";
146    }
147}
